results.title: JUST-IN- Bandits Kill Traditional Ruler, Scores In Fresh Niger Attack
results.snippet:
Suspected bandits have killed the traditional ruler of Luma Baale community in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State and slaughtered several residents in a fresh attack on the area.

The attackers were also said to have set houses ablaze and burnt the bodies of some of their victims after the killings.
